title: Tax Graph Citation
description: A span-level pointer to authoritative source text, carrying either a verbatim quote or typed computation provenance. Captured once at extraction time and reused at runtime so an agent can show the filer the exact passage instead of re-fetching a PDF.

document_id.description: The source document (carries the tax year).

source_document_id.description: Optional explicit acquired-text document id used for quote verification.

locator.description: Where in the document, e.g. 'Instructions for line 16, paragraph 2'.

quoted_text.description: The verbatim source passage, stored so the agent need not re-fetch.

derivation.description: How a computed result was derived from the cited source table.

ranges.description: Ordered half-open character ranges into source_document_id.

semantic_title.description: The source heading's semantic title, when the acquired source provides one.

url.description: Deep link to the source, if available.

gate.description: Orthogonal provenance axis: who stood at the promotion gate.
